## What it is

Tautulli watches a Plex Media Server and records who watched what, when and on which device, with graphs and notifications ([Tautulli/Tautulli](https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli)). It needs a Plex Media Server to connect to; Plex itself is not in the Market (no licence detected, so excluded in apps/_intake/CANDIDATES.md).

**Licence:** `GPL-3.0` (GitHub licence API). Market class **L2**. There is no license-matrix row yet, so the gate notes that it is not preinstallable on sold boxes until one is added (brief 30 B10).

**Icon:** a neutral generated icon with initials; no upstream logo is shipped.

## Market listing

- Category and sub-tags (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1): media: video. The sub-tags go into `metadata.tags` once the schema has it.
- Deployment class (TAXONOMY §2): **Market · community** until CI writes a passing scan (contract §9.4), then Market · verified if every check passes.

## How it runs here

- One `Deployment` (`Recreate`), one container, as the image's own `tautulli` user (UID 1000). The image's `start.sh` entrypoint changes the user's IDs and then switches to it, which needs root; since the pod already runs as that user, the container runs the image's command (`python Tautulli.py --datadir /config`) directly. No privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped.
- Volume: `tautulli-config` (2 GiB, `/config`).
- Probes: `GET /status` (the image's own health check).

## First run

Source: [Tautulli wiki, Installation](https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/wiki/Installation).

1. Install Tautulli from the Market and approve the action. It installs into `app-tautulli`.
2. Forward the port and open http://localhost:8181:
   ```sh
   kubectl -n app-tautulli port-forward svc/tautulli 8181:8181
   ```
3. The setup wizard asks you to sign in with your Plex account and pick your Plex Media Server. Set a Tautulli username and password in the wizard: until then anyone who can reach the page can use it.
